title: Die Of Death
description: Replaces Minecraft entities with "Die of Death" characters
body:
# Description This resource pack changes Minecraft entities into characters from the Roblox game "[Die of Death](https://www.roblox.com/games/71895508397153/Die-of-Death)". ## Required Mods This resource pack requires the following mods to function correctly: ### Entity Model Features [https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features] ### Entity Texture Features [https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures] ## Modified Entities Zombie -> Pursuer Husk -> Avoider Drowned -> Classic Skeleton -> Badware Stray -> Goodware Blaze -> Harken Creeper -> Killdroid Evoker -> Artful Vindicator -> Artless Pillager -> Banana Peel Illusioner -> Devesto Villager -> Civilian (All Abilities) Enderman -> MeQuot Vex -> Devesto Allay -> Artistry Iron Golem -> Orchestraful ## Credits Based on "[Die of Death](https://www.roblox.com/games/71895508397153/Die-of-Death)" by Saucefy10.
All music, sound effects, and character concepts are based on the Roblox game Die of Death.
I do not own any of these assets.
